method: Read on main: src/, src-tauri/src/, crates/. 'backend' = logic or a command exists and is tested, but no UI path reaches it.

sidebar.home-entry.why: Sidebar Home button works (src/components/Sidebar.tsx); no go-to-Home shortcut is wired (keybinding registry declares commands only).

sidebar.repo-groups.why: Repos render as collapsible groups with nested workspace rows (Sidebar.tsx, store toggleRepo).

sidebar.repo-order.why: crates/openconductor-db/src/repos.rs lists repos by display_order, created_at and appends new ones at the end, but the app does not depend on that crate and the sidebar renders insertion order from localStorage.

sidebar.repo-hide.why: No hide/unhide; hidden column exists only in the unwired DB crate schema.

sidebar.add-repo.why: Sidebar '+' opens the Open-project dialog, which only appends to localStorage; it does not call the registered add_repository command.

sidebar.ws-name.why: Row shows the name; no user-set vs generated distinction (user_set_* flags not modelled in the UI).

sidebar.ws-branch.why: Branch appears only in the row tooltip.

sidebar.ws-status.why: Status dot uses our own idle/working/needs-review/archived model, not derived/manual status with in-progress default (src/state/types.ts).

sidebar.ws-diffstat.why: +/- counts render from stored placeholder numbers; not computed from git, no colour setting.

sidebar.ws-unread.why: No unread state, action or command; column only in the unwired DB crate.

sidebar.ws-pinned.why: No pinning; pinned_at only in the unwired DB crate.

sidebar.sections.why: No sections UI or commands; navigation_sections only in crates/openconductor-db/migrations/0005_navigation_and_favorites.sql (unwired).

sidebar.ws-numbers.why: No numbers or Cmd+1..9 handler; registry entries in src/keybindings are declarations without handlers.

sidebar.ws-next-prev.why: Declared in the keybinding registry only; no handler.

sidebar.rename.why: No user rename. src/workspace/naming.ts plans the automatic first-message rename only, and is not imported by the UI.

sidebar.archive.why: UI archive (WorkspaceView) deletes the localStorage row without confirmation or busy check. Backend WorkspaceManager::archive has the busy guard and archive commit but is not a registered command.

sidebar.archived-view.why: WorkspaceManager::restore exists (src-tauri/src/workspace/mod.rs); no command, no UI.

sidebar.resize-toggle.why: Toggle works via Cmd+B and '[' (src/state/shortcuts.ts, App.tsx); the sidebar is a fixed 248px column with no resize.

sidebar.ws-actions.why: No row context menu or actions menu.

sidebar.empty-state.why: Muted single-line empty state matches evidence/screens/home.md.

sidebar.add-menu.why: '+' opens a dialog directly; no three-action menu, no recents.

sidebar.visibility-settings.why: Visibility persists inside the localStorage app state, not as a setting; width is fixed (248px vs evidence default 256).

home.route.why: Home is the default screen, but there is no router or '/' route (selection state in src/state/store.ts).

home.org-states.why: No organization concept; no loading or cloud redirect state.

home.layout.why: Matches evidence/screens: three label-only cards in a 1-to-3 grid sit at the reference position (y 368-495; x offset 4 px from the narrower sidebar), wordmark centered above, drag region, fade-in. Differences: card icons for GitHub (cloud vs globe) and Quick start (sparkle vs folder-plus); the wordmark is our own brand by design.

home.sidebar-toggle.why: Toggle shown only when the sidebar is hidden, with tooltip and shortcut hint (HomeScreen.tsx).

home.add-local.why: Dialog with folder picker adds to localStorage with defaultBranch hard-coded to main; backend add_repository (git toplevel) and default_branch detection exist but are not called.

home.open-project-flow.why: Only the backend toplevel check exists (service.rs add_repository). No .git/init dialog, origin check, file:// remote or error toast.

home.clone-github.why: Dialog parses GitHub URLs but performs no clone and has no destination picker or progress.

home.new-project.why: Quick start dialog with placeholder templates; no git init, no GitHub repo, no first workspace on disk.

home.duplicate-repo.why: Store silently ignores a duplicate path/remote; no already-exists message. Backend add_repository returns the existing id.

home.no-repo-guard.why: Sidebar empty line exists; creating a workspace with no repository is not reachable, and no Home explanation is shown.

home.status-overview.why: Home shows no workspace list or statuses.

home.recents.why: Clone dialog has no recent repositories.

home.persist.why: UI state lives in localStorage; backend keeps a TSV repo registry; the Conductor-shaped SQLite schema in crates/openconductor-db is not used by the app.

create.entry.why: Per-repo '+' instantly adds a localStorage row with an adjective-noun name; no dialog, no worktree.

create.from-ref.why: src/workspace/createFlow.ts models PR/branch/issue sources with tests; not used by the UI.

create.base-branch.why: create_workspace accepts a base branch and fetches origin/<base> first (mod.rs create); createFlow defaults it to the repo default branch; no UI.

create.branch-picker.why: list_branches command is registered; no picker UI.

create.worktree.why: create_workspace runs git worktree add -b <branch> <data_dir>/workspaces/<slug>/<name> <base>; registered but never invoked by the UI.

create.branch-prefix.why: naming.ts resolveBranchPrefix and settings keys exist; no settings UI and not wired to creation from the UI.

create.placeholder-name.why: City names with rarity tiers and first-message rename plan (naming.ts, tested); the UI still uses src/state/names.ts adjective-noun names.

create.validation.why: validateWorkspaceName/validateBranchName (naming.ts) and git check-ref-format (git.rs valid_branch_name); no UI surfaces errors.

create.copy-files.why: files_to_copy.rs resolves .worktreeinclude / globs / .env* and create() copies them; only reachable through the unwired command.

create.setup-script.why: run_setup exists but create() does not call it and no log path is kept.

create.initializing.why: createFlow.ts progress reducer (initializing -> setting_up -> ready/failed); no UI.

create.failure.why: Failed state modelled in createFlow.ts; no failure UI and no startup cleanup of incomplete workspaces.

create.first-message.why: createFlow.ts carries the first message in the create request; no composer and no session start on create.

create.number.why: No workspace numbers (schema column only in the unwired DB crate).

create.autostart-run.why: crates/scripts parses a scripts.auto_run_after_setup setting, but nothing acts on it and that crate is not an app dependency; workspace::scripts::spawn_run is never called after setup.

sidebar.top-bar.why: No in-sidebar toggle button (toggle is keyboard-only, plus a Home button when hidden) and no back/forward navigation; the reference shows all three at the top of the sidebar.

sidebar.computer-switcher.why: Sidebar starts with our logo and name; the reference starts with a computer/account switcher.

sidebar.primary-nav.why: Home row only; no Create or Search rows.

sidebar.workspaces-group.why: We show an uppercase 'Repositories' header with a '+'; the reference shows a sentence-case 'my workspaces' label.

sidebar.footer-actions.why: Footer shows app name, version and platform text; the reference shows help and settings icon buttons.

sidebar.colors.why: Measured on REA captures at 1440x900: sidebar edge at x=248 vs 256; dark sidebar #121417 vs #1c1817; light sidebar #eeeeeb vs #fcfcfb. REA compare-web-screenshots (threshold 24): 3.1% (dark) / 5.4% (light) of sidebar pixels differ.

home.colors.why: Measured: dark main #17191d vs #141110, dark card #24272d vs #211e1c; light main #f7f7f5 vs #ffffff, light card #efefec vs #fafaf9. Every pixel differs at threshold 0 (REA compare-web-screenshots).
